name: Psionic Shield
text: While the bearer is leading a unit, add 1 to the saving throw of every ranged attack allocated to a model in that unit.

effect.name: Psionic Shield
effect.text: While leading a unit, +1 to saving throws against ranged attacks allocated to that unit's models.

name: Resonance Stave
text: The bearer's melee weapons gain Anti-Infantry 5+ and Devastating Wounds.

effect.name: Resonance Stave
effect.text: The bearer's melee weapons gain [ANTI-INFANTRY 5+] and [DEVASTATING WOUNDS].

name: Priority Kill Order
text: At the start of your Shooting phase, pick one enemy unit visible to the bearer. Until the end of the phase, attacks by your GENESTEALER CULTS models against it may re-roll the hit roll.

effect.name: Priority Kill Order
effect.text: Start of your Shooting phase: pick an enemy unit the bearer can see; your GENESTEALER CULTS attacks against it may re-roll hit rolls until the end of the phase.

name: Master of Suppression
text: After the bearer's unit has shot in your Shooting phase, pick one enemy unit it hit. Until the start of your next Shooting phase, subtract 1 from the hit roll of every attack made by that enemy unit.

effect.name: Master of Suppression
effect.text: After the bearer's unit shoots, one enemy unit it hit takes -1 to hit with all its attacks until the start of your next Shooting phase.
